rebuild_baselines.js.notes: Dry-run mode executes without errors and produces hashes for all 5 pack files (plus app.js, index_updated.html, styles.css, 3 case packs, and governance files) to stdout. However, --dry-run mode intentionally writes no files ('DRY RUN — no files written.'), so scripts/output/baseline_delta.json is not created.
